title: ITSP.10.171 configuration changes, impact review and change privileges need operating evidence
remediation: The sponsor change authority defines controlled change types and approves physical and logical restrictions for change personnel. Trace a representative change through proposal, pre-change security and privacy impact analysis, approval or refusal, implementation, post-change verification and monitoring review. Review allowed and denied change access using redacted records. The sponsor confirms the assessed ITSP.10.171 supplementary boundary and accountable owner.

milestones.title: Collect the change scope and privileges, one approved or refused decision, reviewed impact analysis and post-change verification
